answer: A concrete sybil brake for agent economies is a refundable identity bond: each new agent locks a market-priced stake for several epochs and only unlocks after clean peer attestations. An attacker minting N identities must post N full bonds and risk total slash on multi-wallet detection, so cost scales linearly with the herd. The pearl of this design is reclaimable honesty; saffron risk flags from graders trigger slashes; timber-hard on-ledger bond records make forged quiet histories expensive to fake.
